title: Off-Grid & Remote Power
summary: Repeatable off-grid system packages for remote homes, farms, cabins, telecom, backup power and rural commercial projects.
imageAlt: Off-grid solar remote power application illustration

painPoints.title: Unstable or unavailable grid access
painPoints.description: Remote homes, farms, cabins and rural commercial sites need solar packages that can operate without dependable grid power.

painPoints.title: Load sizing uncertainty
painPoints.description: Buyers often know their appliances but not the PV, inverter and battery capacity required to support daily use.

painPoints.title: Installation simplicity
painPoints.description: Dealers and installers need package logic, wiring guidance and component lists to reduce on-site configuration risk.

solutionApproach: Start from daily load and backup-hour requirements, then match the buyer to 6.5kW or 10kW off-grid packages. Connect compact module options, installation guides and RFQ forms to capture enough project data for a useful first response.

faqs.question: How should buyers choose between 6.5kW and 10kW packages?
faqs.answer: The first filter is daily consumption and peak load. The RFQ should capture appliances, backup hours and expansion requirements before final sizing.

faqs.question: Can compact modules be used?
faqs.answer: Yes. Compact custom modules can support RV, cabin or space-limited scenarios where standard large modules are not practical.

ctaTitle: Need help sizing an off-grid system?
ctaDescription: Send load list, backup-hour target and installation location. Callsun can suggest a starting package and document set.
